title: The Tent of Meeting Outside the Camp
description: Moses pitched a tent outside the camp and called it the tent of meeting. All who sought the Lord went there. When Moses entered the tent, the pillar of cloud would descend and stand at the entrance, and all the people would rise and bow down, each at the entrance of their own tent. The Lord would speak to Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend. Joshua son of Nun, his young assistant, did not leave the tent.
